# Doctor Saleem Andraws Dental Clinic

> Dental clinic in Duhok, Kurdistan Region, Iraq, providing dental care in Kurdish (Badini), Arabic and English.

Doctor Saleem Andraws Hana graduated in dentistry from the University of Baghdad in 2007. He earned an M.Sc. in Oral and Maxillofacial Radiology in Duhok in 2023 and has been a member of the Kurdistan Dentists Syndicate, Duhok Branch, since 2014.

The clinic provides dental implants, veneers, orthodontics, fillings, root canal treatment, crowns, whitening and care for children. It uses a 3D intraoral scanner for digital impressions and digital planning with surgical guides for suitable implant cases. Treatment depends on an individual examination.

Address: Qazi Mohammad Road, Sherko Nuts Building, first floor, opposite Hanasa Pharmacy, Duhok, Iraq. Free and paid parking are available. There are approximately 20 steps before the lift; the entrance is not step-free.

Opening hours: Saturday–Thursday, 3:00–9:00 PM, local time; closed Friday. Call to confirm an appointment: +964 750 781 6500 or +964 778 166 5000.
